messages:
leo-rm: Quick help needed for TrustBank POC (tenant=trustbank-poc). Azure AD SSO works for some users but SCIM group sync failing with 403 and hosted API key creation blocked with 'missing auth_method'. Can infra/security triage?

sam-se: Do we have a redacted SAML assertion and the SCIM request id?

leo-rm: Assertion snippet from their admin export: ```<NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:emailAddress">j.smith@trustbank.com</NameID><Attribute Name="http://schemas.microsoft.com/claims/authnmethodsreferences"><AttributeValue>http://schemas.microsoft.com/claims/methods#pwd+mfa</AttributeValue></Attribute>``` SCIM id=scm_f223.

maya-support: SCIM 403 log: `{"status":403,"detail":"service principal missing Group.ReadWrite.All","scim_request_id":"scm_f223"}`. Looks like Azure provisioning app doesn't have Graph group write consent.

priyanka-devex: For hosted keys our authn guard expects `auth_method` claim to be one of `mfa` or `pwd+mfa`. Their claim is namespaced URI. We can either ask them to map a friendly claim or accept the URI for POC after approval.

zach-sre: Checklist: (1) Confirm Azure provisioning app has app-only `Group.ReadWrite.All` and admin consent. (2) Verify the OAuth token in their SCIM Authorization header matches the SCIM secret we issued (kid). If mismatch, rotate secret. (3) If groups conflict produce 409, collect externalId from payload.

leo-rm: Asked customer to attach one SCIM request header and confirm permissions. They returned header with Bearer token and token kid that doesn't match. IT says they copied an old secret.

maya-support: I'll walk them through rotating the SCIM secret from Console and updating Azure provisioning app. After rotation they must run a full sync.

leo-rm: Customer rotated token and re-ran sync. SCIM now creates users but group updates for two groups still error 409 duplicate externalId. Payload shows `externalId: ext-g-55`. They reuse externalId across apps.

priyanka-devex: Recommend unique externalId per Redwood group. Short-term we can clear the stale mapping for ext-g-55 after confirming which Azure group to keep. I'll prepare instructions and a rollback plan.

zach-sre: Also security note: for hosted key demo, ask them to add a claim mapping that emits `auth_method: pwd+mfa` (strip URI) in Azure. If they can't, we can request a 48h security exemption to accept URI-prefixed values.

idp-bot: Observed 5 assertions in last 30m with namespaced authnmethod values. Correlation cid-cc7.

leo-rm: Customer will try claim mapping and let us know. Action items: maya-support -> confirm SCIM token rotation success; zach-sre -> prepare mapping to safely clear stale externalId; priyanka-devex -> draft exemption note if needed. Will update here. :thumbsup:
